profile.headline: Web Designer and Frontend Developer
profile.summary: Specialties: marketing, branding and identity, graphic design, social media, winery compliance, entrepreneur coach, trainer, website design, WordPress

positions.title: Adjunct Faculty Instructor
positions.description: BA 275 Wine Marketing provides a study of wine marketing and sales from the perspective of the Washington State wine industry.  The course examines industry standards and emerging trends relating to wine packaging, promotion, pricing, and distribution.  Emphasizes strategic branding, consumer behavior, and marketing plans for wineries and wine products.

positions.title: Web Content Coordinator
positions.description:
Web Content Coordinator  is responsible for YVC's public website. The Web Content Coordinator will design, write, and manage content as well as provide strategic guidance for the long-term planning of YVC's site. This is a highly collaborative position requiring strong interpersonal communication and teamwork skills that support YVC's distributed model of web maintenance.

The coordinator will work closely with YVC's web development team on technical aspects of the website along with establishing and implementing web policies, procedures, and standards.

As part of the Community Relations team, the coordinator is responsible for ensuring the voice and style of YVC's web presence is consistent, and that the website is integrated into the College's overall communication and marketing activities.

positions.title: Consultant/ Graphic & Web Designer
positions.description: Marketing consulting and training services including branding, website, and social media. Business and marketing planning for emerging and growing businesses. Website design and hosting, graphic design and illustrations.  TTB bond applications and compliance. Label design and submission for wineries, breweries and distilleries. Catering and culinary services for wineries.

positions.title: Creative & Digital Marketing Specialist / Social Media
positions.description: I am excited to join this team after working with them since 2008 as a consultant. In this staff position I create marketing materials, help drive our digital marketing strategies across a range of channels and in alignment with our strategic plan and business objectives. With a blend of strategic thinking, creativity, and technical proficiency, I help raise our online visibility and drive more traffic through our digital channels by helping to define, implement and measure our online brand building and lead generation efforts. Working as a member of the Marketing & Tasting Room team, I develop and execute ideas and strategies that will connect with and engage our target audiences.

positions.title: Adjunct IT Business Instructor
positions.description: Instructed students in various computer and business technology courses at the YVCC - Grandview campus. Courses included: Introduction to Computers, Windows, Desktop Publishing, Database, Spreadsheets and PowerPoint.  Worked with a variety of skill levels and coached students that required additional assistance after classroom hours in the computer lab.

positions.title: Grant Coordinator and Instructor
positions.description: Implement grant activities for USDA Rural Business Enterprise, USDA Hispanic Serving Institution, and Spark/EWU grants. Schedule seminars and workshops, locate trainers and facilitate, promote seminars/workshops, conduct and organize interviews, forums, community meetings, and workshops. Conduct and train students/community members on business and entrepreneur seminars. Monitor and manage budget, manage contracts, complete and submit reports for grant, develop promotional materials, maintain websites, and managing documentation. Locate new grant opportunities, coordinate, write, and manage grant submission process.

positions.title: Data Management and Document Production
positions.description:
Developed multiple WordPress websites for use in promotion and data collection  
Wrote and edited copy for website 
Analyzed data, coordinated, developed copy, and formatted written report
Managed data and conducted data analysis for FIRE 20/20’s Multicultural Health & Safety (MHSRP) study conducted in Calgary, Seattle, Milwaukee, and Austin.
Managed and developed surveys deployed online and in focus groups.
MHSRP was funded by the Department of Homeland Security.
positions.insights: Skills: Website Updating · Report Writing · Web Content Writing · Website Building · Data Analysis

positions.title: Market Research
positions.description: Plan and conduct market research to determine potential for product success, communicating results to management. Utilize market research to build, manage, and measure the effectiveness of the company's brand positioning. Monitor trends that indicate the need for new products and services. Create marketing copy and design for marketing materials. Coordinate tradeshow and conference displays.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Develop strategic plans, facility planning, organizational reviews, and data analysis. Plan and conduct market research to determine potential for product success. Utilize market research to build, manage, and measure the effectiveness of the company's brand positioning. Develop business and marketing plans for businesses. Conduct marketing plan reviews, website construction, and graphic arts services.

positions.title: Communications Director
positions.description: Coordinate all external communications for the irrigation district. Develop and supervise printing of internal newsletters.  Update and develop company materials. Maintain and update website.  Update tradeshow materials. Conduct and design presentations to organizations and regulatory agencies.

positions.title: Marketing
positions.description: Develop and implement marketing strategies and objectives for software developed for the fire service market. Organize and coordinate annual conference for users in Reno, NV as well as regional user group meetings. Write and coordinate press release and corporate external communications. Write and distribute company newsletter to users and potential users. Coordinate tradeshow and conference displays and promotion.

positions.title: Assistant ED & Director of Volunteer Management and Marketing
positions.description: Effectively promoted Girl Scout membership through outreach, extension, and volunteer coordination throughout council jurisdiction of E. Washington and N. Idaho. Girl Scouts Inland Empire Council covers more than 52,000 square miles. Supervised membership and training staff.  Developed and managed budget. Promoted Girl Scouts through community presentations, networking, and collaborative efforts. Developed and maintained council website. Produced council publications distributed to over 6,000 members.

company.name: Girl Scouts Eastern Washington and Northern Idaho
